title: Molecular hybridization modification improves the stability and immunomodulatory activity of TP5 peptide.
authors: Wang, Junyong; Tang, Yuan; Zhao, Xuelian; Ding, Zetao; Ahmat, Marhaba; Si, Dayong; Zhang, Rijun; Wei, Xubiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TP5与YW12D杂合肽的稳定性与免疫调节活性，虽涉及分子动力学模拟，但核心是肽-受体(TLR2)互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Thymopentin (TP5) plays an important role in host immunomodulation, yet its bioavailability is significantly limited by its short half-life. YW12D is a peptide with strong stability but relatively weak immunoactivity. Tuning the physicochemical properties of such molecules may yield synthetic molecules displaying optimal stability, safety and enhanced immunological activity. Here, natural peptides were modified to improve their activity by hybridization strategies. A hybrid peptide YW12D-TP5 (YTP) that combines TP5 and YW12D is designed. The half-life of YTP in plasma is significantly longer than that of YW12D and TP5. YTP also displays an improved ability to protect the host from CTX-induced weight loss and thymus and spleen indices decrease than YW12D and TP5. In addition, YTP promotes dendritic cell maturation and increases the expression of cytokines IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha and immunoglobulins IgA, IgG, and IgM. A combination of antibody-specific blocking assay, SPR, molecular dynamics simulations and western blotting suggest that the immunomodulatory effect of YTP is associated with its activation of the TLR2-NF-small ka, CyrillicB signaling axis. In sum, we demonstrate that peptide hybridization is an effective strategy for redirecting biological activity to generate novel bioactive molecules with desired properties.
abstract_zh: 胸腺五肽（Thymopentin, TP5）在宿主免疫调节中发挥重要作用，但其生物利用度因其短半衰期而显著受限。YW12D是一种稳定性强但免疫活性相对较弱的肽。调节此类分子的理化性质可能产生具有最佳稳定性、安全性和增强免疫活性的合成分子。在此，通过杂交策略对天然肽进行修饰以提高其活性。设计了一种结合TP5和YW12D的杂交肽YW12D-TP5（YTP）。YTP在血浆中的半衰期显著长于YW12D和TP5。YTP还表现出比YW12D和TP5更强的保护宿主免受CTX诱导的体重减轻及胸腺和脾脏指数下降的能力。此外，YTP促进树突状细胞成熟，并增加细胞因子IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α及免疫球蛋白IgA、IgG和IgM的表达。结合抗体特异性阻断实验、表面等离子体共振（SPR）、分子动力学模拟和蛋白质印迹分析表明，YTP的免疫调节作用与其激活TLR2-NF-κB信号轴相关。总之，我们证明肽杂交是重定向生物活性以生成具有所需特性的新型生物活性分子的有效策略。
